sections.label: The care gap
sections.heading: Millions of at-risk patients never reach a specialist.
paragraphs: Diabetic retinopathy is the leading cause of preventable blindness in working-age adults. It is also one of the most treatable conditions—when caught early.

But specialist shortages, long wait times, and travel barriers mean that millions of at-risk patients never make it in for an eye exam until symptoms appear. By then, intervention is harder and outcomes are worse.
Primary care is where most of these patients already go. It is also where retinal screening has been hardest to deploy. Until now.

sections.label: The solution
sections.heading: Retinal screening built for the front line of care.
paragraphs: Nsight360 enables non-specialists—primary care physicians, nurses, endocrinologists, home health aides—to capture retinal images using accessible hand-held or portable cameras. Our AI analyzes each image and produces a clinically actionable report, reviewed by licensed ophthalmologists, within minutes.
No on-site eye specialist required. No workflow rebuild required. Just faster, broader access to sight-saving screening.

items.title: AI-Powered Precision
items.body: Our deep-learning models are built on existing clinical practice guidelines to deliver fast, accurate assessments of diabetic retinopathy and other retinal conditions.

items.title: Camera Agnostic
items.body: Nsight360 works seamlessly with any retinal camera—stationary or portable—from 30-degree to 200-degree fields of view. No lock-in. No proprietary hardware required.

items.title: Portable & Easy to Deploy
items.body: Integrates with hand-held cameras so exams can happen anywhere—from a rural home health visit to a high-volume community clinic—without specialist presence.

sections.label: Who it's for
sections.heading: Built for Teams on the Front Line of Care

items.title: Primary Care Physicians
items.body: Add affordable, in-clinic retinal screening to your practice—creating a new revenue stream while closing a critical care gap.

items.title: Endocrinologists & Diabetologists
items.body: Identify patients with vision-threatening retinopathy in real time during routine diabetes care, then refer to specialists before sight is lost.

items.title: Nurses & Care Teams
items.body: Perform screenings on-site or remotely without an on-site eye doctor. Nsight360's AI-assisted workflow fits team-based care models.

items.title: Home Health Agencies
items.body: Bring retinal screening into the home. Add a new revenue source through diabetic retinopathy exams and improve HEDIS measures for underserved populations.

items.title: Community Health Centers
items.body: Expand access to preventive screening in the communities that need it most—especially where specialty eye care is scarce or unaffordable.

items.title: Remote & Rural Clinics
items.body: Overcome geography. Nsight360's handheld-compatible workflow enables eye screening in regions with no on-site ophthalmology coverage.

items.title: Capture
items.body: Any member of the care team uses a supported fundus camera to capture a retinal image.

items.title: Upload
items.body: The image uploads securely to the Nsight360 platform via HIPAA-compliant transfer.

items.title: AI + Expert Review
items.body: Our AI analyzes the image. A licensed ophthalmologist confirms findings and generates a clinical report.

items.title: Report
items.body: Receive a clinically actionable report—complete with billing codes—within minutes. Refer, treat, or monitor.

items.title: Flexible Pay-As-You-Go
items.body: No subscription fees. No long-term contracts. Pay only for the exams you perform.

items.title: Nationwide Ophthalmology Network
items.body: Our board-certified reading ophthalmologists are licensed across all 50 states, ready to confirm and sign off on diagnoses.

items.title: Patient Education Built In
items.body: Gen-AI powered communication tools help patients understand diabetic retinopathy and the importance of preventive care.

items.title: Training & Ongoing Support
items.body: Your team is fully trained on the platform, camera workflow, and clinical protocols—with continuous technical support on every deployment.
